findings.title: Module entitlements are derived but not enforced server-side
evidence: apps/api/src/middleware/entitlement.ts:142-160 — requireEntitlement(moduleKey) resolves the org's entitlements and throws 402 PAYMENT_REQUIRED when a gated module is not entitled
apps/api/src/middleware/entitlement.ts:163-172 — requireActiveSubscription() exported for subscription-wide gates
apps/api/src/lib/entitlements.ts:48-54 — GATED_MODULES is derived from SUBSCRIPTION_ENABLED_MODULES minus DEFAULT_ENABLED_MODULES

apps/api/src/routes/findings.ts:28, apps/api/src/routes/security-ops.ts:22, apps/api/src/routes/governance.ts:32, apps/api/src/routes/training-hub.ts:15, apps/api/src/routes/service-catalog.ts:15, apps/api/src/routes/qbr.ts:16 — router.use(requireEntitlement(...)) applied after requireAuth + requireOrgAccess on all six gated routers
apps/api/src/__tests__/middleware-entitlement.test.ts:128-165 — 402 tests for canceled/past_due/no-subscription; :167-180 provisioned-module allowance; :206-215 documents the deliberate fail-open
findings.impact: Gated premium APIs (findings, security-ops, governance, training-hub, service-catalog, qbr) are no longer reachable without an active/trialing subscription or an admin-provisioned entitlement.
findings.recommendation: Keep as-is. Residual to track (not a regression): entitlement-resolution failure fails open by design (middleware/entitlement.ts:88-94); add an alert on the error-level log if plan-boundary bypasses must be observable.
findings.note: re-verified at 8d299b8d: middleware present, wired to all six gated routers, and covered by middleware-entitlement.test.ts; unchanged since the 9c0b88c verification. Residual (deliberate, documented in docs/BILLING.md:116-120): lookup failure fails open.

findings.title: `payments` table is never populated; payment history is silently empty
evidence: apps/api/src/routes/webhooks.ts:268-297 — payment_intent.succeeded / payment_failed / canceled upserts the payments table keyed on stripe_payment_intent_id
apps/api/src/routes/webhooks.ts:81-107 — resolveBillingRefs links the payment to the local invoice row when resolvable
apps/api/src/routes/billing.ts:326-359 — POST /billing/sync backfills /v1/payment_intents per customer
apps/api/src/__tests__/webhooks.test.ts:189-260 — tests assert the payments row, invoice link and amount_cents on succeeded/failed events
findings.impact: Payment history is populated from both live webhooks and the manual sync; the portal/admin payments views return real rows.
findings.recommendation: Keep as-is. Address the unchecked-write gap tracked in the new finding 'Stripe webhook DB writes ignore errors and still mark the event processed'.
findings.note: re-verified at 8d299b8d: both write paths (webhook + sync backfill) present and unchanged since 9c0b88c; webhook tests assert the row contents.

findings.title: Missing Stripe webhook events leave refunds, void, and payment lifecycle unrecorded
evidence: apps/api/src/routes/webhooks.ts:302-316 — charge.refunded updates the linked payment to refunded/partially_refunded
apps/api/src/routes/webhooks.ts:318-328 — invoice.voided / invoice.marked_uncollectible map onto the existing void/uncollectible enum values
apps/api/src/routes/webhooks.ts:265-297 — payment_intent.* lifecycle recorded
apps/api/src/__tests__/webhooks.test.ts:262-345 — tests for full refund, partial refund, invoice.voided and invoice.marked_uncollectible
findings.impact: Refund and void lifecycle transitions are now ingested instead of being dropped.
findings.recommendation: Keep as-is. Remaining coverage gaps (best-effort refund update, no charge.dispute/credit_note/trial_will_end) are tracked under BILL-P2-001.
findings.note: re-verified at 8d299b8d: handlers present and tested; unchanged since 9c0b88c (adea562c only touched raw-body/M365 hardening).

findings.title: No refund and incomplete trial/cancel state handling
evidence: apps/api/src/routes/webhooks.ts:302-316 — refund events now handled (the 'no refund' half of the finding is fixed)

supabase/migrations/5302026_supabase_consolidated_fresh_bootstrap_20260529.corrected.v3.sql:521-534 — subscriptions has plan_name/status/current_period_*/amount_cents/currency only; no trial_start, trial_end, cancel_at_period_end, canceled_at or interval
apps/api/src/routes/webhooks.ts:229-243 and apps/api/src/routes/billing.ts:305-319 — subscription upserts drop trial_end, cancel_at_period_end and item quantity
apps/worker/src/tasks/stripe-reconcile.ts:16 — cancel_at_period_end is declared in the StripeSubscription interface but never read
grep 'charge.dispute|credit_note|customer.subscription.trial_will_end' apps/api/src/routes/webhooks.ts → 0 hits
findings.impact: Refunds are recorded, but the mirror still cannot answer 'when does the trial end', 'does this cancel at period end', or represent disputes/credit notes; refunds only flip a payment status (no refund amount/date) and are best-effort (no row created when the payment was never mirrored).
findings.recommendation: Add trial_start/trial_end/cancel_at_period_end/canceled_at/interval to subscriptions and persist them in webhook + sync upserts; store refund amount/date; handle charge.dispute.* and credit_note.* if refunds/disputes matter to finance.
findings.note: re-verified at 8d299b8d: the refund half is fixed (e3a14b5b, present at 9c0b88c); trial/cancel lifecycle fields and dispute/credit-note coverage remain missing.

findings.title: `POST /billing/sync` does not paginate Stripe results
evidence: apps/api/src/routes/billing.ts:256-268 — Stripe calls pinned at invoices?limit=20, subscriptions?limit=10, payment_intents?limit=20; no starting_after/has_more loop
grep 'starting_after|has_more' apps/api/src/routes/billing.ts → 0 hits
apps/api/src/routes/billing.ts:271,302,328 — each response is only consumed when res.ok; a failed Stripe call is silently skipped and the endpoint still returns success {synced}
apps/api/src/__tests__/billing.test.ts:263-358 — sync tests cover tenant scoping only; no pagination or partial-failure test
findings.impact: Customers with more than the page limit have partially mirrored invoices/subscriptions/payments, and a partially failed sync still reports success — a false-success pattern for manual reconciliation.
findings.recommendation: Loop on has_more/starting_after (bounded), report per-object synced/error counts, and return a non-2xx or explicit errors[] when any Stripe call fails.
findings.note: re-verified at 8d299b8d: unchanged since the 20261002 finding; the silent partial-failure behavior is additionally documented in the evidence above.

findings.title: Reconciliation job has no drift detection, alerting, or tests
evidence: apps/worker/src/tasks/stripe-reconcile.ts:75-139 — reads billing_customers + local subscriptions, fetches Stripe subscription state, and only suspends memberships on terminal statuses; it never writes Stripe state back to subscriptions/invoices or compares counts/amounts
apps/worker/src/tasks/stripe-reconcile.ts:141-146 — returns {ok:true} even when errors>0 (per-customer fetch failures are counted but not surfaced)
apps/worker/src/__tests__/tasks/task-handlers.test.ts:67-74 — the only stripe-reconcile test asserts the missing-STRIPE_SECRET_KEY error
infra/digitalocean/prometheus.rules.yml — 7 alert rules, none for task failures, webhook processing or billing drift
apps/api/src/routes/billing.ts:274-277 — invoice 'overdue' is only derived during sync/webhook; no scheduled job flips open→overdue when due_at passes (stripe-reconcile never touches invoices)
findings.impact: If webhooks are lost, the mirror stays stale (entitlements read the stale subscriptions row) and nothing detects or alerts on the divergence; partial reconcile failures are reported as task success.
findings.recommendation: Emit drift metrics (per-org subscription status mismatch, invoice/payment counts and sums), write fetched Stripe state back to the mirror, return failure when errors>0, alert on drift/failure, and add tests for terminal vs past_due suspension and partial failures.
findings.note: re-verified at 8d299b8d: still suspend-only, still no drift metrics/alerting/tests; the job reports ok:true on partial failure.

findings.title: Failed payments produce no notification or dunning visibility
evidence: apps/api/src/routes/webhooks.ts:176-213 — invoice.payment_failed only upserts the invoice; no notification or email is created
grep 'notify|createNotification' apps/api/src/routes/webhooks.ts → 0 hits
apps/api/src/lib/notify.ts:14 — 'billing' is a valid notification module but no billing producer exists (only preference lists in notifications.ts:180 and notification-preferences.ts:13)
apps/web/app/(portal)/portal/billing/BillingPageClient.tsx — no past-due banner or update-card prompt; past_due only gets a badge color (:72)
findings.impact: Customers learn about failed payments only when the reconcile worker suspends their memberships; no dunning or self-serve recovery prompt exists.
findings.recommendation: Create a billing-module notification (plus optional email) on invoice.payment_failed with a link to the Stripe portal, and surface a past-due banner on the portal billing page.
findings.note: re-verified at 8d299b8d: unchanged since the 20261002 finding; no billing notification producer and no dunning UI.

findings.title: Subscription/invoice schema lacks trial, interval, and void-lifecycle fields
evidence: supabase/migrations/5302026_supabase_consolidated_fresh_bootstrap_20260529.corrected.v3.sql:82-89 — invoice_status enum includes void/uncollectible
apps/api/src/routes/webhooks.ts:318-328 — invoice.voided / invoice.marked_uncollectible now write those statuses (void-lifecycle status half fixed)
supabase/migrations/5302026_supabase_consolidated_fresh_bootstrap_20260529.corrected.v3.sql:521-534 — no trial_start/trial_end/cancel_at_period_end/interval/quantity columns on subscriptions
apps/api/src/routes/billing.ts:292-295 — invoices record paid_at only; no voided_at/uncollectible_at timestamps
docs/BILLING.md:26-38 — documents the same minimal column set
findings.impact: The mirror still cannot answer billing-interval or trial-window questions, and void/uncollectible transitions have no timestamp; plan-aware UI/reporting requires live Stripe calls.
findings.recommendation: Add interval, trial_start, trial_end, cancel_at_period_end (and quantity/seat count) to subscriptions; add voided_at to invoices; populate from webhook + sync.
findings.note: re-verified at 8d299b8d: void/uncollectible statuses are now ingested (fix landed in e3a14b5b); trial/interval columns and void timestamps still absent.

findings.title: Webhook raw body typed as `string` but consumed as `Buffer`
evidence: apps/api/src/app.ts:116-118 — express.json verify hook stores req.rawBody = buf.toString() (a string)
apps/api/src/routes/webhooks.ts:152-156 — stripe.webhooks.constructEvent receives (req as { rawBody?: Buffer }).rawBody as Buffer without conversion
apps/api/src/lib/webhook-signature.ts:32-36 — rawBodyBuffer() normalises string|Buffer for the Jira/JSM paths (hardened in adea562c)
apps/api/src/routes/webhooks.ts:377,479 — Jira/JSM now reject when no raw body is captured
findings.impact: Verification works today because the Stripe SDK accepts string|Buffer, but the declared types still contradict each other; a refactor to express.raw or a binary body could break signature verification silently.
findings.recommendation: Capture req.rawBody as a Buffer (buf), type it consistently, and pass it to constructEvent without the cast; add a byte-mutation signature test.
findings.note: re-verified at 8d299b8d: the Jira/JSM paths were hardened (rawBodyBuffer, fail-closed), but the Stripe path still casts a string to Buffer (app.ts:117 + webhooks.ts:153).

findings.title: Billing email stored in plaintext and raw Stripe payment-method id rendered to users
evidence: supabase/migrations/5302026_supabase_consolidated_fresh_bootstrap_20260529.corrected.v3.sql:510-518 — billing_email citext and default_payment_method text stored plaintext
apps/web/app/(portal)/portal/billing/BillingPageClient.tsx:169-173 — renders customer.default_payment_method verbatim
apps/web/app/(admin)/admin/organizations/[orgId]/billing/AdminBillingClient.tsx:183-186 — same rendering in the admin console
apps/api/src/lib/field-encryption.ts — AES-256-GCM field encryption exists but is not applied to billing_customers
findings.impact: Billing contact PII is stored unencrypted and an opaque Stripe pm_... token is displayed to users instead of a friendly card descriptor.
findings.recommendation: Encrypt billing_email with the existing field-encryption helper (or store it in the encrypted PII pattern), and display a card brand/last4 descriptor fetched from Stripe instead of the raw pm id.
findings.note: re-verified at 8d299b8d: unchanged; field encryption is still not applied to billing and both UIs render the raw payment-method id.

findings.title: Stripe webhook DB writes ignore errors and still mark the event processed
evidence: apps/api/src/routes/webhooks.ts:190-210 — invoice upsert result is not inspected (no error destructure)
apps/api/src/routes/webhooks.ts:230-246, :254-261, :281-294, :323-326 — subscription, billing_customers, payment and void/uncollectible writes are equally unchecked
apps/api/src/routes/webhooks.ts:337-340 — after processing, logWebhookDelivery stores the idempotency key as 'done' (webhooks.ts:47) and the route returns 200 {received:true}

apps/api/src/routes/webhooks.ts:338 — only recordWebhookDelivery('success', ...) is emitted; metrics.ts:132 supports a 'failed' status but it is only used by the outbound dispatcher (lib/webhook-dispatcher.ts:224)
supabase-js returns errors as values rather than throwing, so a failed write never reaches the catch at webhooks.ts:341-348
findings.impact: A failed mirror write (enum/constraint drift, transient DB error, malformed payload) is acknowledged to Stripe as success, the event is never retried, and no metric or alert records the loss — silent reconciliation drift.
findings.recommendation: Check every Supabase write result; log and throw (or record a failed delivery metric) on error so the claim is released and Stripe retries; optionally add a dead-letter/reprocess path.
findings.note: new finding at 8d299b8d; closely related to BILL-P2-003 (no drift detection/alerting).

findings.title: Out-of-order or late-retried Stripe events can overwrite terminal payment states
evidence: apps/api/src/routes/webhooks.ts:167-172 — dedup key is stripe-<event.id> only; there is no per-object ordering/version guard
apps/api/src/routes/webhooks.ts:281-294 — payment_intent.* upserts write status unconditionally from the event
apps/api/src/routes/webhooks.ts:302-316 — charge.refunded writes refunded/partially_refunded

apps/api/src/lib/idempotency.ts:50 — event claims expire after 24h, while Stripe retries failed deliveries for up to ~3 days, so a late retried payment_intent.succeeded is reprocessed and can reset the row to 'succeeded'
findings.impact: A refunded payment can silently revert to 'succeeded' in the mirror, so finance/admin views show a refund as collected.
findings.recommendation: Make payment status monotonic (never downgrade refunded/partially_refunded), or compare event.created/updated before writing; treat refunded/voided as terminal states in the upsert.
findings.note: new finding at 8d299b8d; Stripe delivery ordering across objects is not guaranteed and retries can arrive after the 24h claim TTL.

findings.title: Billing read endpoints fall back to all-tenant scope for cross-tenant roles without an admin-scope guard or audit
evidence: apps/api/src/routes/billing.ts:62-64, :119-124, :154-157, :175-180, :195-198 — every GET scopes only on a caller-supplied query.organization_id; with none, the query has no tenant predicate

apps/api/src/middleware/org-access.ts:136-152 and :206-226 — a cross-tenant role holder (isCrossTenantKey, roles.ts:27) with no explicit org resolves to orgId=null and no query.organization_id is injected
apps/api/src/lib/admin-scope.ts:55-57 — the hardened pattern requires profile.is_super_admin AND a cross-tenant role for allTenants; billing GETs never call resolveAdminTenantScope/applyOrgScope
apps/api/src/routes/billing.ts:219 — only POST /sync uses resolveAdminTenantScope
apps/api/src/middleware/org-access.ts:194-204 — impersonation is only logged when an explicit org was resolved
findings.impact: An 'admin'-key holder without is_super_admin can read all tenants' invoices, payments, subscriptions and summary (no impersonation audit entry), diverging from the MT-P1-002/ADMIN-P1-001 allTenants policy.
findings.recommendation: Adopt resolveAdminTenantScope + applyOrgScope/applyRequestedOrg on the billing GETs (fail closed for empty scope) and audit implicit cross-tenant reads.
findings.note: new finding at 8d299b8d; the web UI always sends organization_id, so the gap is reachable via direct API/SDK use.

findings.title: `invoice.paid` paid_at handling writes epoch dates (sync) or throws when status_transitions is missing (webhook)
evidence: apps/api/src/routes/billing.ts:292-295 — new Date((inv.status_transitions?.paid_at ?? 0) * 1000).toISOString() writes 1970-01-01 for a paid invoice without paid_at

apps/api/src/routes/webhooks.ts:204-207 — new Date(inv.status_transitions?.paid_at * 1000).toISOString() throws RangeError when status_transitions/paid_at is undefined (undefined * 1000 = NaN → Invalid Date)
apps/api/src/routes/billing.ts:33 — the local type declares status_transitions?: { paid_at?: number | null } | null, so a missing value is expected to be handled
findings.impact: Sync can persist epoch timestamps; the webhook can 500 and repeatedly retry-fail for that event (claim released on failure), leaving the invoice unrecorded.
findings.recommendation: Guard both branches (paid_at = status_transitions?.paid_at ? new Date(paid_at*1000) : null) and add tests for paid invoices with and without status_transitions.

findings.title: Payments list uses an inner join, hiding payments not linked to an invoice
evidence: apps/api/src/routes/billing.ts:177-180 — select('*, invoices!inner(invoice_number, status)', { count: 'exact' })
supabase/migrations/5302026_supabase_consolidated_fresh_bootstrap_20260529.corrected.v3.sql:558-565 — payments.invoice_id is nullable (references invoices on delete set null)
apps/api/src/routes/webhooks.ts:343 — invoice_id stays null when the PaymentIntent has no Stripe invoice or the local invoice row is not yet mirrored
findings.impact: One-off/unlinked payments never render in the admin payments table and are excluded from the reported total count, even though they are stored.
findings.recommendation: Use a left join (`invoices(invoice_number, status)`) so unlinked payments still list with a null invoice column.

findings.title: Entitlement override cannot revoke all modules (all-disabled falls back to the subscription set)
evidence: apps/api/src/lib/entitlements.ts:102-108 — provisioned = rows where enabled; if provisioned.length === 0 the resolver falls back to deriveEnabledModules(subscriptionActive)

apps/web/app/(admin)/admin/client-portal/ClientPortalEntitlementsForm.tsx:56,:71 — the admin form saves every PORTAL_MODULES entry (enabled true/false) and states 'Saving overrides the subscription-derived default set'
apps/api/src/routes/client-portal.ts:88 — the bootstrap payload uses the same precedence, so client and server agree
findings.impact: An admin who unticks every module cannot revoke the gated set: with an active/trialing subscription all six gated modules are re-enabled on both the client and the server.
findings.recommendation: Treat the existence of provisioned rows (enabled or not) as an explicit override, or store an override flag; add a test for the all-disabled case.

findings.title: Subscription mirror ignores seat quantity and the billing summary excludes trialing plans
evidence: apps/api/src/routes/webhooks.ts:229-243 and apps/api/src/routes/billing.ts:305-319 — only items.data[0].price is read; item quantity and multi-item subscriptions are dropped
supabase/migrations/5302026_supabase_consolidated_fresh_bootstrap_20260529.corrected.v3.sql:521-534 — subscriptions has no quantity/seat column

apps/api/src/routes/billing.ts:73-77 — activeSubscriptions counts status='active' only, excluding trialing, while isSubscriptionActive (apps/api/src/lib/entitlements.ts:56-58) treats trialing as active
apps/web/app/(portal)/portal/billing/BillingPageClient.tsx:118-119,:146 — labels the count 'Active Plans' and hardcodes '/mo' for every subscription
findings.impact: Seat-based plans display the per-seat unit amount as the plan total (understating revenue), and trialing tenants show 0 active plans in the summary while the plan card shows a trialing subscription.
findings.recommendation: Persist item quantity and billing interval (or the computed total), use the shared isSubscriptionActive predicate in the summary, and render the billing period from stored interval data.
findings.note: new finding at 8d299b8d; 'seat counts' and 'usage billing' are absent from the mirror (grep for usage_record/meter/quantity in billing paths returns no hits).

findings.title: Portal 'Sync from Stripe' button is shown to client roles that lack billing:manage
evidence: apps/web/app/(portal)/portal/billing/BillingPageClient.tsx:197-203 — the Sync button is rendered for every portal member
apps/api/src/routes/billing.ts:207 — POST /billing/sync requires requirePermission('billing','manage')

supabase/migrations/5302028_seed_permissions.sql:58-88 — client_admin/client_user/client-viewer grants exclude billing; only client-billing (supabase/migrations/5302128_role_catalog_expansion.sql:267-274) and MSP roles hold billing.manage
apps/web/e2e/portal/billing.spec.ts:19-25 — the e2e asserts the Sync button is enabled
findings.impact: Most portal users see an action that returns 403 and renders the generic 'Sync error.' message; the billing.ts:378-382 comment even states the catalog does not grant billing:manage to client roles.
findings.recommendation: Hide/disable the button unless the caller holds billing.manage (or return a typed 403 the UI explains).

findings.title: Billing docs contradict the implementation (sync gate, webhook verification, reconcile source, payment statuses)
evidence: docs/BILLING.md:100-102 — 'Requires stripe-signature header (validated for presence)' but webhooks.ts:150-163 fully verifies the signature via constructEvent
docs/BILLING.md:132-138 — the reconcile task is documented as querying memberships; stripe-reconcile.ts:75-110 queries billing_customers then subscriptions
docs/modules/billing.md:41 — 'Manual sync: requireAdmin'; billing.ts:207 uses requirePermission('billing','manage')
docs/BILLING.md:68 — payments status documented as succeeded/failed/pending; code also writes refunded/partially_refunded (webhooks.ts:310)
findings.impact: Operators and future agents get a wrong model of the access gate, webhook verification, reconcile inputs and payment statuses.
findings.recommendation: Refresh docs/BILLING.md and docs/modules/billing.md to the implemented behavior, including STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET and the refund statuses.

# Billing, Payments, and Reconciliation Audit

## Audit Metadata

- Audit name: repo-deep-dive
- Run: `mainecybertech-20261011-0426-full-main-8d299b8`
- Repository: MaineCyberTech/mainecybertech (target worktree `/tmp/opencode/mct-audit-target`)
- Branch: `main`

- Output path: `docs/audits/repo-deep-dive/mainecybertech-20261011-0426-full-main-8d299b8/29_billing_payments_reconciliation_audit.md`

## Executive Summary

Billing is a Stripe mirror (webhooks + manual sync + daily reconcile) with a server-enforced entitlement layer. The three P1 findings from the previous run are genuinely fixed and re-verified at `8d299b8d`: entitlements are enforced with `requireEntitlement` on all six gated routers, the `payments` table is written by both the webhook and `POST /billing/sync`, and refund/void/uncollectible lifecycle events are ingested. The customer portal has a Stripe-hosted billing portal, and tenant scoping on `POST /billing/sync` was hardened.

The remaining risk is not missing features but **silent drift and false success**: webhook DB writes are never checked (a failed mirror write is still acknowledged as processed), `POST /billing/sync` does not paginate and silently skips failed Stripe calls while reporting success, and the reconcile job neither detects drift nor alerts (it even returns `ok:true` with per-customer errors). A late-retried Stripe event can also overwrite a refunded payment back to `succeeded`. Plan-state fidelity is limited (no interval/trial/cancel/seat fields), and failed payments still have no notification or dunning path. Recommended next actions: (1) fail webhook writes loudly + metric; (2) paginate sync and report partial failures; (3) add drift metrics/alerts and reconcile logic tests; (4) migrate billing reads to the hardened `admin-scope` pattern; (5) add trial/interval/seat columns and dunning UI.

## Detailed Review (highlights)

### Item: Stripe webhook processing

- Evidence: `apps/api/src/routes/webhooks.ts:131-349`.
- What it does: verifies the Stripe signature with `constructEvent`, claims `stripe-<event.id>` atomically (TTL 24h), maps invoice/subscription/payment/refund/void events, writes an audit event + delivery row, releases the claim on thrown errors.
- Current controls: signature verification, atomic dedup, best-effort `resolveBillingRefs`, PII-safe delivery logging.
- Missing controls: every Supabase write result is ignored (`:190-210`, `:230-246`, `:254-261`, `:281-294`, `:323-326`); no inbound failure metric; no ordering/monotonic guard; refunds only update an existing row.
- Risks: silent mirror drift; refund state overwritten by late retries; failed writes acknowledged as processed.

### Item: `POST /billing/sync`

- Evidence: `apps/api/src/routes/billing.ts:207-376`.
- What it does: resolves and authorizes the target org, fetches invoices/subscriptions/payment_intents per customer, upserts with `onConflict` on Stripe ids, audits `billing.sync`.
- Current controls: `billing:manage` gate, `resolveAdminTenantScope` check, audit event.
- Missing controls: fixed page sizes (20/10/20) with no `starting_after`; non-`ok` responses skipped silently; no row/error counts in the response.
- Risks: false-success reconciliation; stale history for high-volume customers.

### Item: `stripe-reconcile` worker

- Evidence: `apps/worker/src/tasks/stripe-reconcile.ts:57-152`.
- What it does: daily (env-gated) per-org fetch of the active/trialing (else most recent) subscription; suspends approved memberships on terminal Stripe statuses; never touches invoices or writes Stripe state back.
- Missing controls: drift metrics, alerting, state write-back, meaningful tests; returns `ok:true` even when `errors>0` (`:146`).
- Risks: undetectable drift; entitlements keep reading stale local subscription state.

### Item: Entitlements

- Evidence: `apps/api/src/lib/entitlements.ts`, `apps/api/src/middleware/entitlement.ts`, wired in 6 routers, `middleware-entitlement.test.ts`.
- Strengths: single source of truth shared by bootstrap and middleware; 402 envelope; 30s cache; admin bypass; tested.
- Gaps: all-disabled provisioning falls back to the subscription set (`entitlements.ts:102-108` vs the admin form's "Saving overrides the subscription-derived default set"); deliberate fail-open on lookup error.

## Findings

Canonical records (severity, evidence, status, note) are in `29_billing_payments_reconciliation_audit.json`. Titles:

1. **Module entitlements are derived but not enforced server-side** — P1, `verified-fixed` (re-verified at 8d299b8d).
2. **`payments` table is never populated; payment history is silently empty** — P1, `verified-fixed`.
3. **Missing Stripe webhook events leave refunds, void, and payment lifecycle unrecorded** — P1, `verified-fixed`.
4. **No refund and incomplete trial/cancel state handling** — P2, `partially-fixed`.
5. **`POST /billing/sync` does not paginate Stripe results** — P2, `still-open`.
6. **Reconciliation job has no drift detection, alerting, or tests** — P2, `still-open`.
7. **Failed payments produce no notification or dunning visibility** — P2, `still-open`.
8. **Subscription/invoice schema lacks trial, interval, and void-lifecycle fields** — P2, `partially-fixed`.
9. **Webhook raw body typed as `string` but consumed as `Buffer`** — P3, `still-open`.
10. **Billing email stored in plaintext and raw Stripe payment-method id rendered to users** — P3, `still-open`.
11. **Stripe webhook DB writes ignore errors and still mark the event processed** — P2, `open` (new).
12. **Out-of-order or late-retried Stripe events can overwrite terminal payment states** — P2, `open` (new).
13. **Billing read endpoints fall back to all-tenant scope for cross-tenant roles without an admin-scope guard or audit** — P2, `open` (new).
14. **`invoice.paid` paid_at handling writes epoch dates (sync) or throws when status_transitions is missing (webhook)** — P3, `open` (new).
15. **Payments list uses an inner join, hiding payments not linked to an invoice** — P3, `open` (new).
16. **Entitlement override cannot revoke all modules (all-disabled falls back to the subscription set)** — P3, `open` (new).
17. **Subscription mirror ignores seat quantity and the billing summary excludes trialing plans** — P3, `open` (new).
18. **Portal 'Sync from Stripe' button is shown to client roles that lack billing:manage** — P3, `open` (new).
19. **Billing docs contradict the implementation (sync gate, webhook verification, reconcile source, payment statuses)** — P3, `open` (new).
